response.sql: WITH processing_with_site AS (SELECT sp.*, s.insurstat FROM scanprocessing sp INNER JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), group_stats AS (SELECT zoneref, insurstat, AVG(remaingb) as avg_remain, AVG(proccpu - procgpu) as avg_cpu_gpu_gap FROM processing_with_site GROUP BY zoneref, insurstat), mean_result AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) as global_mean_remain FROM group_stats) SELECT gs.zoneref, gs.insurstat, gs.avg_remain, gs.avg_cpu_gpu_gap, CASE WHEN gs.avg_remain IS NOT NULL AND m.global_mean_remain IS NOT NULL THEN gs.avg_remain / m.global_mean_remain ELSE NULL END as remain_ratio FROM group_stats gs CROSS JOIN mean_result m WHERE m.global_mean_remain IS NOT NULL ORDER BY remain_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
